question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

 (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) YDGK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/048aa59b2f4eba99feee8a25e0aeac83de2dcbc7e57ff18d1c41827953f7a24a.png] 

Option 2) GLOS

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/177bb2eb45b1990fe7930ac847fcb0f76a489c13d0a1ff70250b521517f8ec3e.png] 

Option 3) EJNQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff299bd7400daf67bb74dc1db0a1f92949e611dc069cb45b711dc9e749311641.png] 

Option 4) ZEHL

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ab97bd05527667f5b2edf3a9509e9df80d30d6c0076422a2d9da6389c38556f.png] 

Thus, out of all 'EJNQ' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
